note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 283; the original is in English. The species name in the original entry heading is printed as “ceylot:licus”, an OCR corruption of ceylonicus. The synonym list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule light brown, the nasus slightly darker than the head; antennae straw-coloured; pronotum light brown, darker anteriorly. The vertex with 1 pair of long setae, the base of the nasus with 2–4 hairs, not densely covered with fine hairs as in other species; the pronotum with fine hairs; the abdominal tergites with numerous short hairs, with 1 pair of long setae in the middle and 1 on each side, the sternites densely covered with long and short hairs. Body length 3.2–4.0 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped, length including the nasus 1.30–1.50, length excluding the nasus 0.79–0.95, maximum width 0.75–0.92 mm; nearly straight in lateral view, with an indistinct nasus. The nasus short, conical, length 0.50–0.55 mm, its ratio to the head length 0.56–0.59, bearing a tuft of long and short hairs at the apex. Antennae 12–13-segmented; with 12 segments segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Mandibles reduced, each with a distinct spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.18–0.20, width 0.40–0.46 mm, the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, antennae, labrum and postclypeus slightly paler than the head; abdomen yellowish white. Head and body densely hairy. Body length 2.8–3.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular, length to the mandibular base 0.85, maximum width 1.00 mm. Fontanelle plate white, translucent, slightly elongate, length 0.13 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus swollen, hairy, half as long as wide, length 0.20, width 0.45 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.25, width 0.45–0.53 mm, the anterior margin slightly concave or without a concavity.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule chestnut brown; antennae, labrum and postclypeus brown; abdominal tergites chestnut brown, sternites light brown. Head and body moderately densely hairy. Body length 7.4 mm. Head capsule subsquare, length to the mandibular base 0.80–1.01, width including the eyes 1.20 mm; coronal suture indistinct. Fontanelle plate 0.11–0.14 mm long, narrow, translucent. Eyes small, subcircular, maximum diameter 0.31–0.36, minimum diameter 0.29–0.34 mm. Ocelli oval, translucent, long diameter 0.13–0.17, short diameter 0.08–0.11 mm, about their short diameter from the eyes, that is, 0.07–0.12 mm. Antennae 14–15-segmented; with 14 segments segment 3 subequal to segment 2 and segment 4 shortest; with 15 segments segment 3 half the length of segment 2 and also the shortest. Postclypeus swollen, hairy, less than half as long as wide, length 0.14–0.17, width 0.43–0.53 mm, the anterior margin incurved, the posterior margin convex. Pronotum subtrapezoidal, length 0.43–0.53, width 0.79–0.95 mm, the anterior margin straight and slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin deeply concave. Wings light brown with a smoky tinge, densely hairy, fore wing 8.80–10.6 mm long; the micrasters of the wing membrane are papillae on the anterior and posterior margins and coarse non-stellate (3–6-armed) micrasters on the membrane.
